name: Schalksmühle (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schalksmühle (a cogwheel on yellow above a chequy bar and oak leaves on green).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 30 March 1972 the municipality was granted the right to bear a flag and a banner; the banner is green and red in two equal stripes with the municipal shield in the middle of the upper half.

features.role: Schalksmühle arms — cogwheel, chequy bar and oak leaves
